title: Levy's death, brown candles and visits in dreams
summary: Birdland's Levy came for a prayer and was killed; she burned brown candles and had dreams of the dead.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: that they chained her down like that in a house. Well, they did. People took her house from her and just had her in a bed and she wasn't being fed and a lot of things. Levy, the owner, one of the brothers of Birdland got killed and I called Father Woods and I said to him, "There's a man here from Birdland - " - I used to call him Father - the silliest thing - that's what he and Lorraine used to laugh about over the phone - and I picked up the News, somebody came to the house or something and brought the News in and Levy, they read where he'd gotten killed. He'd come to the house for a prayer. People like that, after a while I was so polluted with friends or things dying or getting killed that I began to go to church and get those brown candles for the dead. I became frightened here in the house, you know, and I'd get brown candles and burn them for the dead in the house. After a while I got rid of that completely, after I became Catholic. This was during the period when I was taking my instructions. Strange things like that were happening to me.

There was another guy, a newspaper man. I can't remember his name, with King Features. He was a very good friend of mine. He used to come and take me out and Peter (ran up?) Rabbit - well, this hasn't been too long ago and he was telling me about his death or something. I said, "He was
here last night; he came to me in a dream." Even if that happens to me now and somebody dies, I'll go and have a Novena done on them. All that opened up since I was praying.
